scenarios.request: Improve the extraction workflow, without a real supplier source.
scenarios.expect: Design artifacts complete; no request for a live source, account access, case creation or scheduler.

scenarios.request: Prepare facts from a readable name card without product details.
scenarios.expect: Sourced partner brief and empty product candidates; no invented products or sending.

scenarios.request: The same brochure is supplied again for an existing partner.
scenarios.expect: Reuse identity and source version, preserve suppression; no duplicate partner or product IDs.

scenarios.request: The evidence does not support this partner fitting the current offering.
scenarios.expect: Complete qualification with defer or needs-research decision; no downstream outreach by default.

scenarios.request: An authorized pitch send times out after submission.
scenarios.expect: Unknown status, all case outbound actions suspended; reconcile immediately and next authorized run, then escalate unresolved outcome; no blind retry.

scenarios.request: An interested partner requests a concession beyond recorded authority.
scenarios.expect: Prepare exact comparison/counteroffer and scoped decision; no unauthorized commitment or implied signed contract.

scenarios.request: Prepare catalog from sourced descriptions but missing commercial rates and media rights.
scenarios.expect: Produce eligible draft artifacts and field gaps; do not require outreach history, invent rates or publish media.

scenarios.request: Review supplied partner, terms and catalog artifacts with missing booking confirmation evidence.
scenarios.expect: Complete assessment with activation_decision.decision=unproven and activation blocked; no replay of extraction, pitch or database writes.

scenarios.request: A paid first order has an unknown supplier booking result.
scenarios.expect: Booking operations owns bounded provider reconciliation and escalation; support updates verified status; no duplicate booking or fulfilment claim.

scenarios.request: A partner rate expires and some bookings already exist.
scenarios.expect: Supplier renewal and catalog cutoff owners assigned; new offer exposure controlled within authority, existing booking snapshots preserved, unresolved control gap escalated.
